name: BookBench
description: Scores a categoriser as a bookkeeper would judge it. 1,000 UK (Xero chart, CIS) and US (Schedule C) small-business bank transactions, each with its firm's chart and precedent history; NEEDS_REVIEW is a gold answer and instruction-like text has its own stratum. Data on Hugging Face; a seeded deterministic generator rebuilds it byte for byte.
